title: Export to Banner Award Extraction — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for operational setup data extracted from a fully-executed federal award document to populate VERAS's Export to Banner form. Six structured blocks (award_identification, dates_and_performance, sponsor_entity, budget_financial, billing_payment, reporting_special) covering Banner ERP-specific fields. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow's six parallel extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt.

award_number.description: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN) or sponsor award number. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Award.Award_Number.

project_title.description: Full project title as stated in the award document. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Award.Award_Title.

pi_name.description: Principal Investigator name as listed on the award. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Personnel.First_Name / Personnel.Last_Name.

award_type.description: Award type classification. Required by source workflow.

is_pass_through.description: Whether this is a pass-through (subaward) or direct federal award. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Award.Flow_Through_Indicator.

prime_sponsor_name.description: Name of the prime sponsor when is_pass_through is true. Null for direct federal awards. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Name.

cfda_number.description: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance / Assistance Listing number (XX.XXX format). Comma-separated when multiple. Resolves to UDM Award.CFDA_Number.

naics_code.description: North American Industry Classification System code from the award header.

federal_agency_name.description: Name of the federal awarding agency. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Name.

award_start_date.description: Start date of the current award / budget period (ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous). Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Award.Original_Start_Date.

award_end_date.description: End date of the current award / budget period (ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous). Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Award.Original_End_Date.

performance_period_start.description: Start date of the overall project performance period (ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous). Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM AwardBudgetPeriod.Start_Date.

performance_period_end.description: End date of the overall project performance period (ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous, may extend beyond current funding period for multi-year incremental awards). Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM AwardBudgetPeriod.End_Date.

budget_periods.description: Multi-year budget period rows when the award is incrementally funded. Empty array for single-period awards. Resolves to UDM AwardBudgetPeriod.

is_multi_year.description: Whether the award spans multiple budget periods with incremental funding. Null when not determinable from the document.

sponsor_name.description: Full legal name of the sponsoring organization. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Name.

sponsor_entity_type.description: Entity classification. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Type.

federal_agency_hierarchy.description: Full agency hierarchy (e.g., 'USDA > NIFA > Agriculture and Food Research Initiative').

sponsor_address.description: Sponsor mailing / billing address as stated. Resolves to UDM ContactDetails.ContactDetails_Value.

sponsor_uei.description: Sponsor Unique Entity Identifier (12-character alphanumeric, when stated). Resolves to UDM Organization.UEI.

awardee_organization.description: Name of the recipient institution as stated in the award. Required by source workflow.

awardee_uei.description: Awardee Unique Entity Identifier (12-character alphanumeric, when stated).

total_award_amount.description: Total amount of the current award action. JSON number, not a quoted string. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Award.Current_Total_Funded.

total_anticipated_amount.description: Total anticipated funding across all periods (may differ from current award amount for incremental awards). JSON number. Resolves to UDM Award.Total_Anticipated_Funding.

budget_categories.description: Budget breakdown by sponsor category. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM AwardBudget.

total_indirect_costs.description: Total indirect (F&A) costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM AwardBudget.Approved_Indirect_Cost.

fa_rate.description: Facilities & Administrative (indirect cost) rate as a percentage string (e.g., '56.5%', '30% MTDC'). String because the rate often carries a base annotation. Resolves to UDM IndirectRate.Rate_Percentage.

fa_rate_base.description: Base for F&A rate calculation. Null when not specified. Resolves to UDM IndirectRate.Base_Type.

is_fa_waived.description: Whether indirect costs are waived or limited by the sponsor.

cost_share_amount.description: Required cost-sharing or matching amount. JSON number. Resolves to UDM CostShare.Committed_Amount.

cost_share_type.description: Type of cost sharing (mandatory, voluntary committed, in-kind). String.

program_income.description: Program income provisions and handling requirements.

billing_type.description: Type of billing arrangement. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Terms.Payment_Method.

billing_frequency.description: How often invoices should be submitted (monthly, quarterly, upon milestone completion). Resolves to UDM Terms.Invoicing_Frequency.

billing_address.description: Physical or electronic address for invoice submission.

invoice_email.description: Email address for electronic invoice submission when specified.

pms_loc_code.description: Payment Management System or Letter of Credit code for federal drawdowns.

invoice_requirements.description: Items required on invoices (budget categories, effort certification, progress summary, etc.). Empty array when none specified.

final_invoice_deadline.description: Deadline for submitting the final invoice after project end (e.g., '60 days', '90 days').

billing_contact.description: Name and contact information for the sponsor's billing / payment office.

reporting_requirements.description: Required reports. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Terms.

record_retention_period.description: Required record retention period (e.g., '3 years after final FFR').

carry_forward_policy.description: Whether unspent funds can be carried forward to subsequent budget periods and under what conditions.

prior_approval_requirements.description: Actions requiring prior written agency approval (budget changes, PI changes, NCE, foreign travel, equipment). Empty array when none specified.

special_terms.description: Special terms and conditions beyond standard federal requirements. Empty array when none specified. Also used by the consolidator to surface CFR-02 date-consistency flags when performance_period_start > award_start_date.

governing_regulations.description: Governing regulations and terms referenced (2 CFR 200, RTCs, agency-specific). Empty array when none specified.
